title: Typed routes
hints: Split the job: first a helper `ParamNames<S>` that produces a *union* of names (`"id" | "postId"`), then map over that union to build the object.

Template literal patterns can `infer` pieces: `S extends `${string}:${infer Name}/${infer Rest}`` captures one param followed by more path. Recurse on the rest; handle the "last param, no slash after it" case separately.

type ParamNames<S extends string> = S extends `${string}:${infer P}/${infer R}` ? P | ParamNames<R> : S extends `${string}:${infer P}` ? P : never;  type Params<S extends string> = { [K in ParamNames<S>]: string };
